extensionDescription.message: Save the page to your local Netami Pin library in one click. Links wait in a queue while the app is closed.

queueWaiting.message: Netami Pin: $COUNT$ waiting to be sent. Open the settings to see the queue.

badgeQueued.message: Link is in the local Netami Pin queue

badgeWaiting.message: Link is waiting to be sent to Netami Pin

badgeExisting.message: This link is already in Netami Pin

errorInvalidUrl.message: This page can't be saved. Open a page with an HTTP/HTTPS address.

errorUnsupportedScheme.message: This page can't be saved. Only HTTP/HTTPS links are supported.

errorUnavailable.message: Netami Pin is unavailable. The link is waiting to be sent.

errorNoConfirmation.message: No confirmation that the link was saved

errorNoToken.message: Connect the extension: paste the connection key in its settings.

errorTokenFormat.message: Copy the full connection key from Netami Pin → Connect browser.

errorTokenRejected.message: The connection key doesn't match. Copy the current key from Netami Pin.

optionsIntro.message: Save a page in one click. Links wait for the app in a local queue.

connectionNotPaired.message: Paste the connection key to connect the extension to the app.

connectionReady.message: Netami Pin is running. The connection is set up.

connectionUnavailable.message: Netami Pin is closed or unavailable. Links will stay in the queue.

tokenLabel.message: Connection key from Netami Pin → Connect browser

tokenSaved.message: Key saved. Waiting links will be sent to the app.

queueEmpty.message: The queue is empty. Open an interesting page and click the Netami Pin icon.

optionsFooter.message: Data stays in the browser and on your computer. To send links, both the browser and Netami Pin must be running.
